source.name: 33rd Annual PEI Giant Pumpkin & Squash Weigh-Off
source.description: TODAY’S THE DAY! A family-friendly day featuring giant pumpkins, produce, activities, and fall fun. Entries for the weigh-off must arrive between 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM; the weigh-off starts at noon. Categories include Giant Pumpkin, Giant Squash, Field Pumpkin, Long Gourd, Marrow, Giant Tomato, Bushel Gourd, and Watermelon. Around 1:30 PM, a 1,000 lb pumpkin filled with candy will be lifted by crane and dropped. Activities include free wagon rides, free kids’ activities, Field-of-Fun, and a paid corn maze. Free public admission; rain or shine.
source.price: Free public admission; $20 per category to register an entry
source.extractionReason: The annual weigh-off is an advertised public entertainment event, with an explicit date anchor in “TODAY’S THE DAY!” and a stated weigh-off start time. Its on-site activities are included in this single event rather than split into separate events.
